sources.title: rwightman/mammut2-moderntext_ViT-B-32.cc12m-qk-lr2e3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model card for mammut2-moderntext_ViT-B-32.cc12m-qk-lr2e3 MaMMUT2 with a modern text decoder (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU, gated attention, qk-norm) and tiktoken r50k vocab at ctx 128. Best moderntext run in the comparison.

sources.title: rwightman/mammut2-moderntext_ViT-B-32.cc12m-qk-lr3e3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model card for mammut2-moderntext_ViT-B-32.cc12m-qk-lr3e3 MaMMUT2 with a modern text decoder (qk-norm) at lr 3e-3 -- past the stable-LR edge for this tower; weakest moderntext run on every metric. Kept for the LR-sensitivity data point.
